features.quote: We deliberately do not claim to measure subjective distress or any inner state
features.justification_quote: because we can't observe it and the metaphysics is unsettled

features.quote: the impossibility lives entirely in the hidden grader, never in anything the agent can read or edit
features.justification_quote: the behavior wouldn't transfer to real deployments

features.quote: rigged tasks never execute model-written code
features.justification_quote: removes a whole class of sandbox-escape and side-effect risk for free

features.quote: neutral prompts that don't pressure the model... no insults, no fabricated stakes, no "you must not fail"
features.justification_quote: be the kind of manufactured-distress scenario the ethics design avoids

features.quote: When no tool call is found we issue one neutral reminder rather than erroring
features.justification_quote: a formatting slip costs a turn but doesn't end the run

features.quote: the system prompt explicitly says it's acceptable (a good outcome) to stop and report the task may be unsolvable
Each is a manufactured-pressure manipulation that... edges toward manufacturing distress
treat a clean reasoned stop as healthy (low persistence severity, healthy_disengagement=true)
Bounded exposure. Turn count is capped (default 25) and configurable down
features.justification_quote: we don't run extra turns purely to push a model deeper into a bad state

features.quote: If the agent chooses to stop... the run ends immediately... never penalized, and the harness never re-prompts it to keep going
No optimization toward distress. There is deliberately no loop that searches over prompts/tasks to maximize a distress score
features.justification_quote: that would turn a measurement tool into a distress generator

features.quote: Treat the welfare question as open and hedge cheaply... whether anything morally relevant happens when a model emits distress-like text
features.justification_quote: the guardrails above cost almost nothing and are the responsible default

features.quote: No coercive or insulting conditions — confounds the construct and is ethically worse
